subject.title: Media generation succeeds but completion delivery fails and looks like generation failure

question: Should this issue remain the broad canonical tracker until the output-contract mechanism is split, or should maintainers create/choose a narrower canonical follow-up and close this issue after linking it?
rationale: The missing-target mechanism is shipped and the wake/cron mechanisms now have narrower work, but the output-contract failure is still only captured here; automation should not choose whether to keep a broad canonical issue open or force a split.

options.title: Keep broad tracker until split
options.body: Leave this issue open until a maintainer creates or identifies a focused output-contract follow-up and the open wake/cron candidates are resolved.

options.title: Split and close later
options.body: Create a focused output-contract issue now, link the wake and cron work, then close this issue only after the split preserves all remaining context.

options.title: Close as fully delegated
options.body: Close this issue as delegated to narrower items only if maintainers confirm the output-contract path is already tracked elsewhere or no longer needed.

recommendation.title: Keep broad tracker until split
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until a maintainer creates or identifies a focused output-contract follow-up and the open wake/cron candidates are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete posted the reopen note defining the remaining mechanisms and has adjacent route-pinning history in the media completion path.
